checks.quote: F_X_conserved = 1
checks.reason: The numerator adds X-derived CO2 to net X-carbon loss, double-counting the same carbon when X is oxidized to CO2; complete oxidation can give a negative conserved fraction.

checks.quote: independent tissue sources

checks.quote: All experiments below are **proposed**; no new results are asserted.

checks.quote: multiple of negative-control variance
